# King City Disposal

> Family-owned roll-off dumpster rental serving Mount Vernon, Fairfield, and 35+ towns across Southern Illinois. Same-day delivery, transparent pricing (from $475 for a 20-yard / 10-day rental), no hidden fees.

Phone: (618) 231-8481
Email: kingcitydisposal@gmail.com
Service area: 35-mile radius centered on Fairfield, IL
Fleet: 10× 20-yard dumpsters, 15× 30-yard dumpsters

## Core pages

- [Homepage](https://www.kingcitydisposal.com/): Overview, pricing snapshot, testimonials
- [Book a dumpster](https://www.kingcitydisposal.com/book): Multi-step booking form with map placement and Stripe payment
- [Pricing](https://www.kingcitydisposal.com/pricing): 20-yard $475 / 30-yard $575, 10-day rentals, $100/week extensions, $105/ton weight overage
- [Dumpster sizes](https://www.kingcitydisposal.com/dumpsters): Side-by-side comparison of 20yd vs 30yd
- [Service area](https://www.kingcitydisposal.com/service-area): Interactive map and list of 35+ towns served
- [FAQ](https://www.kingcitydisposal.com/faq): Common questions about pricing, sizes, prohibited items, weight limits
- [Contact](https://www.kingcitydisposal.com/contact): Phone, email, hours, contact form
